scene_description: Three young children wearing colorful ski gear and helmets are on a snowy ski slope with an adult instructor. The children are on skis and wearing bright yellow vests. The instructor wears a red jacket and white helmet.

questions.question: What are the children wearing on their heads?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the top of each child's head.

questions.question: What are the children standing on?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the children's feet and the ground below them.

questions.question: Who is wearing a red jacket?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person on the right side of the picture.

questions.question: Where are the children?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the ground all around the children.

questions.question: What color are the vests the children are wearing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the bright vests on the children's bodies.
